attendance.note: Third-party figure (Sun to Sun, Google snippet): '14.000 asistentes ultima edición', written before the 2026 edition. The 2026 edition sold out; El Debate reports planning assumed about 4,000 attendees and that figure was amply exceeded. Organiser numbers not published.

add_sources.note: Motorbeach runs the festival plus motorcycle tours, challenges and a rally raid ('Festival, Viajes, Desafíos, Rally Raid', IG bio); contacts info and pau at motorbeach.com.
Google snippet: 'Motorbeach Festival 2026 Del 9 al 12 de julio' in Vinuesa, Soria. JamBase's 9 to 11 Jul was wrong.

Oct 2026: 'LA INVERNAL 2027, del 26 de febrero al 1 de marzo, Playa de Palomares (Cuevas del Almanzora, Almería)'. Site programme page refers to 'Motorbeach Festival en Almería' for 2027; no Vinuesa 2027 date found.
Vinuesa mayor has 'grandes dudas' about the event continuing there; authorities to review the incidents.

2026 sold out; planning assumed about 4,000 attendees, 'ampliamente superada'. A 24-year-old rider died after an on-site crash; two more accidents; about 435 administrative complaints (unregistered or uninsured motorbikes, drugs, weapons, illegal camping) and 21 road-safety investigations.
